name: OMTech Q3 30W
tagline: 30W Q-switched fiber that works on the bench, split or handheld, for $1,799.99
tldr: The Q3 30W is the entry version of OMTech's 3-in-1 fiber marker, listed on OMTech's store at the end of October 2026. The same machine works as a desktop column, as a split setup with the processing unit off the base, or as a handheld marker with a 3.2 kg quick-release head that keeps the 150 × 150 mm field. OMTech lists 3 mm deep engraving, a 0.06 mm minimum line width, 10,000 mm/s and a 170 mm processing height. At $1,799.99 (OMTech store, October 2026, regular price $3,599.99) it costs about $200 more than a fixed compact 30W fiber; deep engraving is slow, focus is manual and the laser is Class 4.
mainObjective: Affordable metal marking on the bench and on parts too large for a column

engraveExample.description: Filled logo on stainless steel plate

engrave: Some hard plastics and stone (after testing)
cannot: Color marking on stainless (needs a MOPA)

pros: Desktop, split and quick-release handheld modes in one machine, for parts that do not fit under a column
$1,799.99 in October 2026: about $200 more than a fixed Gweike G2 30W, for a larger 150 × 150 mm field and the handheld head
170 mm processing height and 0–30° head tilt for tall or angled parts
cons: Deep engraving is slow: OMTech's own example took about 110 minutes, almost twice as long as on the more powerful version
Manual focus: recheck the height for every part of a different thickness
Class 4 open laser: goggles and a controlled area are required, unlike enclosed Class 1 machines
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 30W version of the OMTech Q3. It suits a first fiber laser for tags, nameplates, tools and jewelry, with the handheld head as a bonus for large parts. Compare the other Q3 version with the chips above if deep engraving or volume matters.
proTips: For deep logos, run several fast passes rather than one slow pass and check depth between them. Use the split mode to keep the processing unit off a small bench, and keep the safety shield and goggles on for every job, handheld included.
primaryUse: 30W version of the OMTech Q3: affordable metal marking on the bench, split or handheld

editorialDepth.advantages: The 30W Q3 is a sensible first fiber for marking metal tags, nameplates and tools, with a feature fixed desktop fibers do not have at this price: a handheld head for objects that cannot go under the column. The 150 × 150 mm field is also larger than on most compact 30W markers.
editorialDepth.limitations: Deep engraving takes a long time at 30W, and focus is manual, which slows mixed batches. As a Class 4 laser it needs goggles and a controlled area, and its Q-switched source cannot produce colors on stainless steel. No owner feedback exists yet.

faq.question: What does 3-in-1 mean on the OMTech Q3 30W?
faq.answer: The machine works as a desktop marker on its column, as a split setup with the processing unit moved off the base (about 15 minutes to convert), or as a handheld marker with the 3.2 kg quick-release head pressed flat against the part. The marking field stays 150 × 150 mm in every mode.

faq.question: Q3 30W or 50W?
faq.answer: Same modes, field, software and manual focus; the difference is speed. In OMTech's deep-engraving example, the 30W took about 110 minutes and the 50W about 60. The 50W costs $900 more ($2,699.99 against $1,799.99 on OMTech's store, October 2026). Take the 30W for shallow marks on tags and tools, the 50W if deep engraving or volume pays.

faq.question: Can the Q3 30W mark wood or plastics?
faq.answer: OMTech designs it for metals: steel, aluminum, brass, titanium, gold and silver. Some hard plastics and stone may work after testing, but OMTech says not to process wood, paper, PVC or PTFE. For wood and leather, look at a diode or a dual laser.

standoutFeatures.title: Handheld head included
standoutFeatures.body: The quick-release head comes off the column and keeps the 150 × 150 mm field, for marking cabinets, panels or parts that cannot be moved to the machine.

standoutFeatures.title: 3-in-1 for $1,799.99
standoutFeatures.body: At $1,799.99 on OMTech's store in October 2026, the Q3 30W costs little more than a fixed compact 30W fiber while adding the split and handheld modes.
